info.description:
Breaking backend release: all Money fields are fixed two-decimal strings and the current frontend is incompatible until migrated.
All failed /api/v1 requests use the apierror.Response schema with stable codes and X-Request-ID. See docs/README.md for the code catalog and frontend migration handoff.
